clips.title: The story
paras: Kodo Hide Bag is a trade quest offered by Veren Tallstrider, a skilled tauren leatherworker atop the high mesas of Thunder Bluff. In exchange for fundamental crafting supplies, he passes on the traditional plains technique for stitching durable travel packs from sturdy beast hide. It serves as an early rite of passage for apprentice leathercrafters in Mulgore.

Perched on Thunder Bluff's crafting rises, Veren Tallstrider upholds the long-standing nomadic tradition of wasting nothing from the hunt. To earn his tutelage, an aspiring leatherworker must present him with cured light leather and sturdy thread. By demonstrating their competence with foundational materials, apprentices prove they are ready to craft goods worthy of carrying survival gear across Kalimdor's rugged expanses.

To the tauren, the kodo beast is an emblem of endurance, strength, and steady resolve. Its thick hide shields against brambles, biting wind, and beast claws alike. Crafting bags and garments from kodo hide is not merely a utilitarian act, but an expression of reverence for the animal that has nourished and carried the Shu'halo through countless generations across the plains of Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy—traits much respected among us. If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.
Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my supplies, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good. Thank you, friend. My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
